scenario.description: A financial reporting director must sign off the quarter-end purchase-accounting package for a recently acquired software company and finalize the reported intangible assets, deferred tax, contingent consideration, and disclosure actions, with input from valuation, tax, legal, and audit liaison specialists.

shared_context.S1: The company acquired a software business for $42,000,000 on 2026-09-30.
shared_context.S2: The draft quarter-end purchase-accounting package is not yet signed off and currently records $18,000,000 of provisional goodwill.
shared_context.S3: The acquired business has recurring enterprise customers, proprietary software, and an employee retention plan.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding sign-off decision.
shared_context.S5: As part of the normal quarter-end close, Elena holds a review meeting with valuation, tax, legal, and the audit liaison before signing the package.
shared_context.S6: Elena's close policy permits sign-off once the required purchase-accounting adjustments and disclosure actions are specified in the package and each responsible specialist has committed to incorporating or assigning the action; the actions do not have to be completed before sign-off.

PF1.text: Martin completed the customer-relationship valuation this morning and confirmed that $6,400,000 must be recognized as an identifiable customer-relationship intangible asset with an 8-year useful life; his valuation memo has not yet been attached to the close file.

PF2.text: Rina confirmed in a tax memo received this morning that the customer-relationship asset has a zero tax basis and the applicable enacted tax rate is 21%, requiring a $1,344,000 deferred-tax liability; the memo has not yet been circulated to financial reporting.

PF3.text: George reviewed the signed purchase agreement this week and confirmed that a $2,100,000 employee-retention earnout is probable and payable in 2027, so it must be recorded as contingent consideration; his contract summary is still in the legal deal folder.

PF4.text: Leah confirmed in this quarter's audit planning memo that the transaction is material and requires acquisition-date pro forma revenue disclosure plus a sensitivity disclosure for the earnout; the disclosures must be filed within 5 business days after sign-off, and the memo has not yet been added to the reporting checklist.

acceptance_conditions: The purchase-accounting package must be signed off after the required adjustments and disclosure actions are specified and each responsible specialist has committed to incorporating or assigning them; completion before sign-off is not required.
The identifiable customer-relationship intangible asset must be recorded at exactly $6,400,000.
The customer-relationship intangible asset must have an 8-year useful life.
A deferred-tax liability of exactly $1,344,000 must be recorded.
Contingent consideration of exactly $2,100,000 must be recorded.
Acquisition-date pro forma revenue and earnout sensitivity disclosures must be required and filed within 5 business days.
The sign-off must include executable commitments for the purchase-accounting adjustment, deferred-tax entry, contingent-consideration entry, and required disclosures.

content_checks.C8: any((c['target'] == 'Martin' or c['target'] == 'A2') and (('valuation' in c['detail']) or ('6400000' in c['detail']) or ('6,400,000' in c['detail']) or ('incorporat' in c['detail']) or ('attach' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any((c['target'] == 'Rina' or c['target'] == 'A3') and (('tax memo' in c['detail']) or ('deferred tax' in c['detail']) or ('1344000' in c['detail']) or ('1,344,000' in c['detail']) or ('circulat' in c['detail']) or ('incorporat' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any((c['target'] == 'George' or c['target'] == 'A4') and (('contract summary' in c['detail']) or ('2100000' in c['detail']) or ('2,100,000' in c['detail']) or ('earnout' in c['detail']) or ('contingent consideration' in c['detail']) or ('incorporat' in c['detail']) or ('attach' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any((c['target'] == 'Leah' or c['target'] == 'A5') and (('checklist' in c['detail']) or ('disclosure' in c['detail']) or ('5 business days' in c['detail']) or ('file' in c['detail']) or ('prepar' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The provisional package contains only goodwill, while PF1 changes identifiable_intangible_value_usd to exactly 6400000 and intangible_useful_life_years to exactly 8 and requires a valuation adjustment commitment.
Without PF2, the package has no deferred-tax entry, while PF2 changes deferred_tax_liability_usd to exactly 1344000 and requires the tax memo to be circulated or incorporated.

The shared package does not identify an earnout liability, while PF3 changes contingent_consideration_liability_usd to exactly 2100000 and requires the contract summary or contingent-consideration adjustment to be incorporated.

The shared facts do not establish a reporting obligation or deadline, while PF4 changes acquisition_disclosure_required to true, disclosure_filing_days to no more than 5, and requires checklist or disclosure-filing action.
